verdict.line: You lose this lane by sitting in Parrrley range and letting Grog-Soaked Blade poison stack uncontested; you win it by closing with W and landing E before Remove Scurvy is up to cleanse it.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's only ranged poke is Parrrley (625 range, 5s cooldown) plus the Grog-Soaked Blade poison his autos apply, and he has zero hard CC of his own — Remove Scurvy only clears CC that's already on him, it can't stop you from landing it. That means Irelia's E (Flawless Duet) stun is uncontested the moment it connects, and W (Defiant Dance) can be timed to blunt the one poke tool he has while you close the gap. The data agrees: Irelia holds lane and solo-kill advantage here, 50.9% over 3093 games.

theirWindow.when: Parrrley is up as you approach
theirWindow.what: He'll fire Parrrley (625 range, 5s cooldown) to stack poison and chip you before you're in melee range. Either eat it and keep closing — Bladesurge's heal offsets it — or walk up along minions to block the shot.

yourWindow.what: Remove Scurvy clears CC on cast but is then down for 22-18s depending on rank. The instant he burns it, your next E (Flawless Duet) stun sticks for its full duration with no way for him to cleanse it — all-in immediately.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the sustained melee trades you're forcing — every auto and spell hit in his face stacks it while BotRK and Death's Dance keep you alive through the poison.

summoners.why: 85.4% pick rate and the top win rate at 51.5%; Ignite closes out the all-ins your E stun opens up, since he has no CC of his own to punish you for committing.

playing.title: Time all-ins around Remove Scurvy
playing.detail: Track when he last used W. Its cooldown is 22-18s depending on rank, so the window right after he burns it is when your E stun is guaranteed to land uncleansed.

playing.title: Charge W into incoming Parrrley
playing.detail: Defiant Dance reduces physical damage taken while charging. Time the charge to absorb his next Parrrley (625 range, 5s cooldown) and release the strike as you close the remaining distance.

playing.title: Chain Bladesurge off E marks
playing.detail: Flawless Duet marks anything it stuns, and hitting a marked target with Bladesurge refreshes its cooldown. Use this to reset your dash for a second engage or a clean disengage.

playing.title: Trade in short bursts, not long
playing.detail: Grog-Soaked Blade's poison scales with his level and ticks over time. Land your burst, then disengage instead of face-tanking extended autos where the DoT outlasts your Bladesurge healing.

playing.title: Side-step Cannon Barrage warning
playing.detail: Cannon Barrage has unlimited range and telegraphs before it lands. Step out of the slow zone rather than contest a trade standing in it.

playing.title: Use R's wall to lock the trade
playing.detail: After Vanguard's Edge hits, it leaves a wall that damages and slows anyone walking through it. Place your all-in so that wall sits behind him, cutting off his retreat.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and win rates above are pulled from measured games on the current patch (OP.GG); the mechanical reasoning — timing windows, cooldown interactions, trade patterns — is my own read of the kit, not sourced data.
